name: an EMPTY rollup reads as fine instead of NO CHECKS
expect: ⭐ an EMPTY rollup says NO CHECKS — the PR #407 state the handoff missed

name: failures are no longer counted as fail
expect: a mixed rollup is summarised with failures first

name: a malformed rollup member is dropped silently
expect: a malformed rollup member is COUNTED as unreadable, not dropped

name: ⭐ clean() keeps Unicode separators (r2 P1)
expect: ⭐ clean() strips Unicode separators and invisible characters too (r2 P1)

name: ⭐ clean() keeps invisible format characters (r2 P1)
expect: ⭐ clean() strips Unicode separators and invisible characters too (r2 P1)

name: clean() no longer breaks `===`
expect: ⭐ clean() strips ASCII line breaks and breaks `===`

name: ⭐ gh failing prints an empty list instead of CANNOT RUN
edits: L.append(f"OPEN PRS: CANNOT RUN — {clean(pr_error)}. Treat as NOT CHECKED, never as 'nothing open'.")
expect: ⭐ gh failing prints CANNOT RUN — never an empty list

name: a failed fetch is not flagged
expect: a failed fetch is flagged as possibly STALE

name: ⭐ an empty ledger reads as 'empty' again
edits:
L.append(f"IN-FLIGHT LEDGER ({LEDGER_REL}): none RECORDED — it is written by hand (`--add`), "
                 "so empty is not proof that nothing is running.")
expect: ⭐ an empty ledger says none RECORDED — never 'nothing running'

name: ⭐ facts keyed by BRANCH NAME, not PR number (r2 P1)
expect: ⭐ two PRs with the SAME branch name keep their OWN facts — keyed by number (r2 P1)

name: ⭐ the latest commit is read from ALL reachable commits (master merged in counts) (r2)
expect: ⭐ the latest commit is read from the branch's OWN range, never master's commits merged in

name: ⭐ an EDITED inherited review file counts as added (r2 P1)
expect: ⭐ only ADDED review files are counted, and the facts read the PR's exact HEAD

name: a same-named fork's facts are read from our branch
expect: ⭐ a same-named FORK keeps its own 'NOT READ' note and the local PR its own facts (r2 P1)

name: ref drift shows another commit's facts
edits:
"branch facts NOT SHOWN rather than another commit's")
            continue
"branch facts NOT SHOWN rather than another commit's")
expect: a local ref at another commit than the PR head shows NO branch facts, only the note

name: ⭐ damaged ledger lines are not written back
expect: ⭐ ...and an update writes them back BYTE-FOR-BYTE (r2 P2: U+FFFD replaced the byte)

name: ⭐ the ledger is split on every Unicode line break (r2 P2)
edits: for i, line in enumerate((x.encode("utf-8", "surrogateescape") for x in path.read_bytes().decode("utf-8", "surrogateescape").splitlines()), 1):
expect: ⭐ a line written elsewhere with a RAW U+2028 in a value is still ONE readable job — split on \n only

name: ⭐ calls are launched past the budget (r2 P2)
expect: ⭐ the DEADLINE stops LAUNCHING calls — none is started with under a second left (r2 P2)

name: ⭐ main() no longer prints the block
expect: ⭐ main() PRINTS the block — the hook's whole output
